## Checklist

- [ ] Source cited in the `source` front matter of every doc I touched
- [ ] No secrets or credentials (1Password item names only)
- [ ] No customer personal data or contacts
- [ ] No compensation or other people data
- [ ] No undecided commercial matters
- [ ] `owner` and `last_verified` updated on every doc I touched
- [ ] Disagreements recorded in `open-questions.md` with who decides (no side picked)
- [ ] Anything unknown marked `UNKNOWN — owner: <name>`
- [ ] One topic per file, English, plain Markdown

## Drafted by AI?

- [ ] Yes. A human reviewer must check the content and merge. AI never merges.
